support_claim: The packet preserves multiple live registry candidates and explicitly states that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, so identity between billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 cannot be established or ruled out.

steps.fact: The left referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. is grounded by invoices.json to the billed name "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
The right referent contract:MSA-NBA-2021 is a master services agreement whose counterparty is named "Northbridge Analytics, Inc."
Commercial notes state that billing and the MSA use the name "Northbridge Analytics Inc." while sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics".
A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC" as an additional registry candidate.
Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs to treat that registry link as unresolved.

No observation supplies a shared legal identifier or other identity-establishing evidence linking the billing referent to the MSA counterparty; name compatibility alone does not satisfy the SAME_ENTITY burden.
No observation establishes that the billing referent and the MSA counterparty are distinct legal entities; absence of identity proof is insufficient for DISTINCT.
